blurb: A fixed asset path names one file, and a Worker serves one file at it, so two assets cannot both claim `/legal.txt`. One path cannot be a folder of another either, as `/logo` and `/logo/icon.png` would be: a name cannot be both a file and a directory. Give each asset its own path. Two assets for the same file at the same path are no conflict. A route at an asset's path is `bynk.asset.shadows_route`.
example:
asset terms = "assets/a.txt" at "/legal.txt"
asset privacy = "assets/b.txt" at "/legal.txt"    // ✗ a second file at `/legal.txt`

asset terms = "assets/a.txt" at "/terms.txt"
asset privacy = "assets/b.txt" at "/privacy.txt"    // ✓
summary: Two different asset files would be served at one fixed path by the same Worker.
